author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a new jump in the horror of mass surveillance. Age verification systems are being rammed down our throats faster than we can expect and now it seems they want to go after our Operating Systems. How will this be done? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!

title: They Want To Age Verify Our Computers Now...
